basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old university student based in New York City, currently pursuing a degree in computer science. I'm passionate about scripting and technology, and I have a keen interest in the dynamics of online communities. When I'm not diving into code or exploring Reddit, you can find me indulging in reality TV shows like Bravo's Real Housewives, or getting lost in the soothing sounds of post-rock music. I typically browse Reddit during the late evenings after my study sessions. I'm single and enjoy exploring different facets of my identity and interests through online interactions.
